sourceFilename: Agenda Package - City Council Closed and Regular Session_Nov19_2024.pdf

audit.basis: Every official HTML attachment matched by agenda item and normalized filename to a unique supplied packet bookmark. Original City URLs and contiguous packet page ranges retained. Outcomes are not inferred from agenda recommendations.

items.title: Conference with Real Property Negotiators Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.8
items.description: Property: Approximately 6.26 acres of vacant land described as North of West 4th street and South of SR 60 and East of Beaumont Crossroads Logistics with APN 424-010-007. Agency Negotiator: City Manager Elizabeth Gibbs or her designee. Negotiating Parties: City of Beaumont as potential Purchaser and LASSEN DEVELOPMENT PARTNERS, LLP, a Delaware limited liability partnership as seller. Under negotiation: Price and Terms.

items.title: Conference with Legal Counsel – Anticipated Litigation – Potential Initiation of litigation pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(4):
National Apprenticeship Week
Popular Annual Financial Reporting and Annual Comprehensive Financial Report Awards
Western Riverside Council of Governments Vehicle Miles Traveled Presentation
Ratification of Warrants
items.recommendation: Ratify Warrants dated: October 25, 2024 November 1, 2024 November 8, 2024

items.title: Approval of Minutes
Performance Bond Exoneration
items.description: Performance and payment bond exoneration for sewer improvements associated with Tract Map No. 27971-11 and for street improvements associated with Parcel Map No. 33681.
items.recommendation: Authorize City staff to issue a Bond Exoneration Letter for Performance and Payment Bonds and Accept Maintenance Security for (Project / Bond Number / Improvement / Maintenance Bond Number): Tract Map No. 27971-11 / 1154356 / Sewer / 1154356M Parcel Map No. 33681 / 4479793 / Street /4479793M

items.title: FY2024-2025 1st Quarter Budget Update and Financial Status Report
items.description: Receive and file a report on the status of the City’s budget and financial status as of September 30, 2024.
items.recommendation: Receive and file report and approve attached budget amendments.

items.title: FY2024-2025 1st Quarter Cash and Investment Report
items.description: Receive and file the 1 st quarter cash and investment report.

items.title: CalPERS Pension Funding Update
items.description: Receive and file CalPERS Pension Funding Update.

items.title: Side Letters Increasing the Cafeteria Plan for Police Managers and the Manager Professional Technical Unit
items.description: Authorize the City Manager to sign side letters with Police Managers and Manager Professional Technical Units increasing the cafeteria plan.
items.recommendation: Authorize the City Manager to sign Side Letter #4 with the Police Managers and Manager Professional Technical Unit.

items.title: Downtown Façade Improvement Program – Funding Agreement Update – 960 Beaumont Avenue
items.description: Revision of an approved funding agreement ED2023-0004 for façade improvements at the property located at 960 Beaumont Avenue.
items.recommendation: Approve the revised funding agreement (ED2023-0004) for façade improvements to the property located at 960 Beaumont Avenue.

items.title: Public Hearing to Award of Fiscal Year 2025-26 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Funds
items.description: Annual review of applications and award of CDBG funding for the upcoming fiscal year.
items.recommendation: Hold a public hearing; and Approve and authorize staff to submit a CDBG application for the City of Beaumont Pedestrian Safety Project and give authority to the City Manager to reduce or increase the amount funded to the projects based on the final amount of funding available to the City of Beaumont; and Approve and authorize staff to submit a CDBG application for Voices for Children in the amount of $10,000 and the remaining amount to the Boys & Girls Club of San Gorgonio Pass, subject to the conditions of the CDBG program as provided by Riverside County EDA.

items.title: Special Event Fee Waiver
items.description: Consideration of Special Event Fee Waiver Request made by Beaumont Cherry Valley Recreation and Park District. Strategic Plan Target #5 – Quality of Life/Well-Being, Priority Level 2, Goal #5 Increase community events, arts and culture .
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, a Resolution of the City of Beaumont Authorizing the Waiver of the Major Event Permit Application Deposit and Associated City Fees for the Annual Beaumont Cherry Recreation and Park District Annual Winterfest Event”

items.title: Authorize a Budget Adjustment, Changes to Position Allocation and Changes to Uniform Compensation Plan
items.description: Staff requests a budget adjustment and authorization for the positions of Community Development Director and Economic Development Director.
items.recommendation: Approve a budget adjustment of $31,157 to department 1350. Approve the addition of one Economic Development Director. Approve a budget adjustment of $147,185 to department 1235.

items.title: Donation Agreement for 6.26 Acres of Real Property
items.description: Donation Agreement between Lassen Development Partners, LLLP, and the City of Beaumont for 6.26 Acres of real property located in the County of Riverside (APN:424-010-007).
items.recommendation: Authorize the City Manager to execute a Donation Agreement between Lassen Development Partners, LLLP, and the City of Beaumont for 6.26 Acres of real property located in the County of Riverside (APN:424-010-007).

items.title: Planning Project and Building Permit Tracking
items.description: Analysis of project and permit tracking with suggestions to reduce processing times and establish measurable results.

items.title: City Council Meeting Dates for 2025
items.description: A review of holidays and conferences in 2025 to avoid a conflict of schedule.
items.recommendation: Approve the list of meeting cancellations and direct the City Clerk’s Office to post cancellation notices for each.

items.title: Approval of City Attorney Invoices for the Month of October 2024
items.recommendation: Approve invoices in the amount of $144,268.26
